summary.text: Amanda Fontana is the Democratic candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 51 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Jodi Salvo.
She currently holds an at-large seat in the New Philadelphia City School District.

paragraphs.text: Amanda Fontana is an officeholder of the New Philadelphia City School District, At-large, in Ohio.
She defeated Angie Hall Pekarek in the Democratic primary for District 51 on May 5, 2026, with 70.2 percent of the vote.
